generic.Defined scope/population: Population is the quarterly review pack, decision log, and RAID extract for the cycle
generic.In-scope period: The current quarterly Executive Portfolio Review cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cycle date, portfolio ID, review date, and record owner tag are populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archive index entry count reconciles to the review decision log
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived files retained in the governance library with cycle date on folder
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or untagged files logged with owner and remediation date
generic.Test population: All files archived for the current review cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every decision log item present in the archived package
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps routed back to the PMO Analyst before the cycle is closed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete archived governance package on file with retention tag applied
generic.Evidence location: Governance record library in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint

steps.title: Pull the review pack, decision log, and RAID extract from Confluence
sop: Open the quarterly Executive Portfolio Review pack, decision log, and RAID extract in Confluence.
Confirm all three artifacts are the final versions signed off from the review cycle.
Done when all three source artifacts are collected for archiving.
verify: Check the collected set against the review meeting agenda.
Pass when all three artifacts are present and marked final.

steps.title: File the package in the SharePoint governance record library
sop: Upload the pack, decision log, and RAID extract to the governance record library in SharePoint.
Name the folder using cycle date and portfolio ID per the naming convention.
Done when the package is filed under the correct naming convention.
verify: Open the filed folder and check the name against the convention.
Pass when the folder name matches cycle date and portfolio ID.

steps.title: Tag each archived file with review metadata in SharePoint
sop: Apply review date, portfolio segment, and record owner tags to each archived file.
Confirm tags are visible in the SharePoint metadata columns.
Done when every archived file carries all three tags.
verify: Spot-check the tag fields on each archived file.
Pass when no file is missing a tag.

steps.title: Apply the PMO records retention period to the package
sop: Set the retention label defined in the PMO records retention schedule on the folder.
Confirm the label applies to the whole archived package, not just individual files.
Done when the retention label is active on the archived package.
verify: Check the retention label status on the archived folder.
Pass when the correct retention period is applied.

steps.title: Cross-check the archive index against the decision log in Confluence
sop: Compare the archive index entries to the review meeting decision log line by line.
Flag any decision log item missing from the archive index.
Done when every decision log item is accounted for in the index.
verify: Review the cross-check result for any unresolved gap.
Pass when the archive index matches the decision log completely.

steps.title: Confirm the archived package is complete and close it out
sop: Review the filed package, metadata tags, and retention label together.
Confirm the cross-check in the prior step found no unresolved gap.
Done when the complete, tagged, retention-flagged package is confirmed on file.
verify: Reopen the archived folder and confirm every check passed.
Pass when the complete governance package with retention tag is on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every active program in the portfolio for the review period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Schedule, cost, benefits, and risk scores are populated for each program
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of scored programs reconciles to the active program list in the PPM tool
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scored scorecard exported and versioned by review period in the BI platform
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Programs with RAG-versus-score disagreement flagged for follow-up
generic.Test population: All active programs scored in the current review period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a current-period score on all four dimensions for every program
generic.Exception handling path: Disagreements between RAG and scorecard routed to the Portfolio Analyst
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current-period health scores recorded for every active program

steps.title: Pull the balanced scorecard from the PPM tool
sop: Open the PPM tool and export the portfolio balanced scorecard for the current review period.
Confirm every active program appears in the export.
Done when the scorecard export covers all active programs.
verify: Check the export row count against the active program list.
Pass when no active program is missing from the export.

steps.title: Score each program on schedule, cost, benefits, and risk
sop: Score every program against the four scorecard dimensions in the PPM tool.
Base each score on the underlying milestone, cost, and RAID data, not opinion.
Done when all four dimensions are scored for every program.
verify: Sample five programs and recompute their dimension scores.
Pass when recomputed scores match the recorded scores.

steps.title: Flag programs where RAG status disagrees with the scorecard
sop: Compare each program's RAG status to its scorecard score in the PPM tool.
Flag any program where the two signals disagree for follow-up.
Done when every disagreement is flagged with the program name.
verify: Review the flagged list against the scorecard export.
Pass when every disagreement identified is captured on the flagged list.

steps.title: Compare current scores to the prior period in the BI platform
sop: Pull the prior-period scorecard from the BI/reporting platform.
Compute the trend direction for each program's four dimensions.
Done when a trend direction is recorded for every program.
verify: Check a sample of trend calculations against the raw scores.
Pass when trend directions are correct for the sampled programs.

steps.title: Publish the scored assessment to the portfolio dashboard
sop: Load the scored health assessment onto the portfolio dashboard in the BI platform.
Confirm the dashboard refresh completed before the review meeting.
Done when the dashboard shows the current-period scores for all programs.
verify: Open the published dashboard and check the scores render correctly.
Pass when the dashboard matches the underlying scorecard data.

steps.title: Confirm the health assessment is complete before the review
sop: Review the published dashboard and flagged disagreement list together.
Confirm every active program carries a current-period score.
Done when the assessment is confirmed complete ahead of the review meeting.
verify: Cross-check the dashboard program count against the PPM tool roster.
Pass when current-period health scores exist for every active program.

verify: Recheck the filter against the full register.

steps.title: Assign a named accountable owner to each unassigned action

Done when every unassigned action has a named owner.
verify: Reopen the register filter for unassigned actions.

steps.title: Set a target resolution date on each newly-owned action
sop: Set a target resolution date on each action just assigned an owner.

Done when every newly-owned action carries a target date.
verify: Sample the newly-owned actions for a populated date field.
Pass when every sampled action has a target date.

steps.title: Notify each assigned owner via the PPM tool
sop: Send the PPM tool task notification to each newly assigned owner.
Confirm the notification includes the action description and due date.
Done when every assigned owner has received a notification.
verify: Check the PPM tool notification log for delivery confirmation.
Pass when every assigned owner shows a delivered notification.

steps.title: Confirm no action remains unassigned before closing the register
sop: Re-run the unassigned-owner filter against the register.

Done when the filter confirms zero unassigned actions remain.
verify: Review the escalation log for any unresolved assignment.
Pass when zero actions remain in unassigned status.

steps.title: Close the register for the cycle and confirm ownership coverage
sop: Review the completed register showing owner and target date on every action.
Confirm the notification log shows delivery to every assigned owner.
Done when the register is closed with full ownership coverage confirmed.
verify: Reopen the register and spot-check five actions for owner and date.
Pass when no open action lacks an accountable owner.

steps.title: Log new action items with due date and owner in Confluence

verify: Cross-check logged actions against the meeting discussion topics.

steps.title: Link each captured action item to the governance actions register
sop: Open the governance actions register in the PPM tool.
Link each captured action item to its corresponding register entry.
Done when every action item has a linked register entry.
verify: Sample five action items and confirm the register link resolves.
Pass when all sampled links resolve to the correct register entry.

steps.title: File the approved minutes in the governance record library
sop: Incorporate any sign-off corrections into the final minutes.
File the approved minutes in the governance record library in Confluence.
Done when the approved minutes are filed under the meeting date.
verify: Open the filed minutes and confirm the approval status.
Pass when the filed minutes show sign-off from attendees.

steps.title: Confirm the minutes and action log are complete
sop: Review the filed minutes against the meeting decisions and action items.
Confirm every action item links to a register entry.
Done when the signed-off minutes with full decision and action log are confirmed.
verify: Reopen the filed minutes and the linked register entries.
Pass when all decisions and action items are logged and linked.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every governance action due for resolution before this review cycle
generic.In-scope period: Actions due prior to the current review cycle

steps.title: Pull actions due for resolution from the PPM tool register
sop: Filter the governance actions register for items due before this review cycle.

verify: Recheck the filter date range against the prior cycle.
Pass when the list contains only actions due before this cycle.

steps.title: Verify closure evidence on actions marked complete

steps.title: Reopen any action lacking evidence instead of auto-closing

verify: Filter the register for complete-status actions without evidence.
Pass when the filter returns zero results after reopening.

steps.title: Re-confirm target dates on actions still in progress
sop: Review target dates on actions not yet resolved.
Update any target date that no longer reflects a realistic timeline.
Done when every in-progress action has a current target date.
verify: Sample five in-progress actions for a plausible target date.
Pass when all sampled target dates are current and realistic.

steps.title: Report the resolution rate to the PMO Manager
sop: Calculate the resolution rate as verified-closed actions over total due.
Prepare a short summary of the resolution rate for the cycle.
Done when the resolution rate is reported to the PMO Manager.
verify: Recompute the resolution rate independently.
Pass when the reported rate matches the recomputed figure.

steps.title: Confirm all verified closures are correctly recorded
sop: Review the verified-closed list and the reopened list together.
Confirm no action was closed without supporting evidence.
Done when all action resolutions for the cycle are confirmed accurate.
verify: Spot-check the register status against the evidence attachments.
Pass when every resolved action carries verified closure evidence.

steps.title: Reconcile evidence against the prior review cycle

Flag any unexplained inconsistency between the two cycles.
Done when the reconciliation against the prior cycle is complete.

Pass when every inconsistency has an explanation or correction.

steps.title: Compile the consolidated evidence pack in the standard template
sop: Load the reconciled status, benefits, and RAID data into the standard review template.
Confirm the template renders correctly with no missing sections.
Done when the consolidated evidence pack is compiled in the standard template.
verify: Open the compiled pack and check each section against the source extracts.
Pass when the pack matches the underlying source data.

steps.title: Confirm the evidence pack is ready for the review meeting
sop: Review the compiled evidence pack for completeness against all in-flight programs.
Confirm amber and red programs carry their RAID extracts.
Done when the evidence pack is confirmed complete for the review.
verify: Cross-check the pack against the in-flight program list one final time.
Pass when the consolidated pack is complete for every in-flight program.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is the findings, decisions, and rationale from the current review

steps.title: Draft the formal governance record from the review findings
sop: Draft the formal governance record capturing findings, decisions, and rationale from the review.

steps.title: Attach accountability assignments for follow-up findings
sop: Attach the accountability assignment for each finding requiring follow-up.

steps.title: Publish the signed-off record to the governance library
sop: Publish the approved governance record to the governance record library in Confluence.

steps.title: Cross-reference the record to the governance actions register
sop: Link each finding requiring follow-up to its governance actions register entry.

verify: Sample three cross-references and confirm the register link resolves.

sop: Draft the escalation note summarizing the action, blocker, and requested directive.

sop: Add the escalated action to the tracking list for the next review cycle.
